rules.title: The project has a manifest
rules.description: PROJECT.md or artifacts/project-manifest.md records purpose, stack, commands, environments, integrations, architectural rules, artifact locations, and current state.
rules.rationale: It is the file a fresh engineer or agent reads first, and nothing else answers what this is and what state it is in.
rules.remediation: Copy templates/PROJECT.md to the repository root and fill it in.
rules.$assuranceNote: Existence is checked; whether its current-state fields are current is not.

rules.title: Consequential decisions are recorded as ADRs
rules.description: artifacts/adr/ exists and holds records for consequential choices, including deliberate deviations from these standards.
rules.rationale: A decision without its rejected alternatives is indistinguishable from an accident.
rules.remediation: Create artifacts/adr/ and record the decisions already made.
rules.$assuranceNote: The evaluator sees whether the directory and records exist, not whether every consequential decision has one.
